message.content:
**"Buenos días, equipo"**

A couple of notes:
- **"Buen día, equipo"** is a common variant in some Latin American countries (e.g., Argentina, Uruguay).
- If addressing a group informally, you might also hear **"Buenos días a todos"** ("good morning, everyone").
